articles.title: Pudo ganar cualquiera en el Gran Canaria y no ganó ninguno
articles.standfirst: Se quedan a medias: Pezzolesi adelantó a la UD, Latasa y Ponceau voltearon el marcador y Elías, tras gran acción de Jesé, puso las tablas
articles.summary: Se quedan a medias: Pezzolesi adelantó a la UD, Latasa y Ponceau voltearon el marcador y Elías, tras gran acción de Jesé, puso las tablas
articles.body: Las Palmas y Valladolid se repartieron dos puntos en un empate 2-2 en el Gran Canaria que dejó sensaciones encontradas y volvió a poner de manifiesto la fragilidad defensiva del conjunto canario. Pezzolesi adelantó a la UD, Latasa y Ponceau voltearon el marcador y el canterano Elías Romero estableció el empate. Así los amarillos encadenan tres partidos sin ganar ante su afición y un solo triunfo en las últimas seis jornadas, mientras los blanquivioletas siguen sin vencer a domicilio. La UD entró al partido con chispa y encontró el premio muy pronto cuando Pezzolesi culminó una gran jugada individual de Iván Jaime para adelantar a los locales con un disparo cruzado ajustado al poste. Sin embargo, el equipo amarillo no supo mantener ese ritmo y fue cediendo terreno ante un Valladolid que aprovechó sus concesiones para darle la vuelta al marcador antes del descanso. Primero, un desajuste entre Bonfanti y Álex Suárez permitió a Latasa aparecer completamente solo y empujar con la cabeza a una portería vacía tras el rechace de Caro a disparo de Víctor Jr. Después llegó el segundo golpe, fruto de un error garrafal de Kirian en la salida: presionado por tres rivales y como último hombre, el centrocampista intentó regatear y perdió el balón, dejando a Ponceau en una situación inmejorable para superar por alto a Caro. Dos errores que volvieron a retratar la debilidad de Las Palmas cuando tiene que defender. Incluso antes del descanso el propio Ponceau, aunque le pitaron falta previa, y Arnu rondaron el 1-3. Tras el descanso, la UD cambió el gesto y salió con mucha más determinación, decidida a recuperar el control del encuentro. Y la reacción tuvo recompensa pronto, con el tanto de Elías Romero, que estrenaba titularidad y aprovechó una acción de enorme talento de Jesé. El delantero se deshizo de Aceves en una gran jugada individual y, cuando buscó culminarla, estrelló el balón contra el poste. El rechace quedó muerto en las botas de Elías, que no perdonó y empujó el balón al fondo de la red para devolver las tablas al marcador. El 2-2 dio alas a los locales, que encontraron en el empuje de la segunda parte una vía para buscar la remontada, aunque sin terminar de traducir su dominio en ocasiones realmente claras. Y eso que Elías pudo hacer el tercero a renglón seguido, pero tras plantarse solo ante Aceves mandó el balón fuera por muy poco. Las Palmas quiso más en el tramo final y los cambios buscaron darle todavía mayor profundidad al equipo, pero el gol de la victoria nunca llegó. El Valladolid resistió, apenas inquietó ya salvo una ocasión de Latasa y otra de Víctor Jr, mientras la UD, pese a su mejor versión tras el descanso y los intentos de Loiodice, Jesé y Manu Fuster, no encontró la precisión necesaria en los últimos metros para completar la remontada. El empate deja así un sabor agridulce para ambos: los pucelanos dejaron escapar una ventaja de 1-2 y Las Palmas volvió a pagar muy caro sus errores defensivos, aunque reaccionó a tiempo para evitar la derrota. Un punto que, visto el desarrollo del encuentro, sabe a poco para los dos y que no termina de servir a ninguno de los contendientes.

articles.title: CFP Playoff Bracket, Scenarios and Bowl Projections After 2026-27 Week 6 AP Rankings

articles.body:
A rare status quo week occurred at the top of the AP Top 25 .

The Texas Longhorns, Georgia Bulldogs, Notre Dame Fighting Irish, Miami Hurricanes and Ohio State Buckeyes remained the top five teams in that order for the second straight week.

In fact, the only notable change came from the Florida Gators' drop from No. 8 to No. 16 following their road loss to the Missouri Tigers.

Missouri worked its way up to No. 14, but it is still on the outside of the projected College Football Playoff positions going into Week 6.

The projections above are based on the current rankings and results through five weeks.

Florida failed to follow up its upset win over the Ole Miss Rebels with another Top 25 victory.

The Gators were blown out by Missouri on Saturday, which caused a drop down to No. 16 in Sunday's AP Top 25.

Jon Sumrall's team received a world of praise in the last week for its 4-0 start, but the breaks were pumped on the hype train after Saturday's result.

The Gators have now gone from a potential surprise playoff team to a ball club that could be holding for its life inside the Top 25 by the end of October.

Florida visits Texas on October 17 and then plays Georgia in Jacksonville on October 31. There's a real possibility the Gators are a three-loss team by the end of that stretch.

An upset could always happen, but right now, the lofty expectations that started to grow in Gainesville have to be tempered after the drop out of the top 10.

The BYU Cougars inched their way up to No. 8, a two-spot leap from No. 10.

BYU picked up two consecutive road wins to move to 4-0 and continue its preparation for an October 17 clash with Notre Dame.

BYU doesn't play the Texas Tech Red Raiders in the Big 12 regular season, so the clash with Notre Dame is the most important matchup in the CFB Playoff context for the Cougars.

The Cougars' positioning in the rankings is important to note, though, because they still might get into the playoff field as a one-loss team with its lone defeat at the hands of Notre Dame. Their toughest game in the Big 12 is the rivalry clash with the Utah Utes.

With BYU, Texas Tech and Utah all inside the top 12, it seems as though the Big 12 is in a far better position than the ACC to get multiple teams into a bracket that is expected to be dominated by Big Ten and SEC schools.

The Gators got blown out 45-17 and fell from No. 8 to No. 16. The top five teams in the AP poll were unchanged, as Alabama's big win over Mississippi State pushed the Crimson Tide up a spot to No. 6 ahead of Indiana.

The Hawkeyes dropped from No. 14 to No. 20 after the loss.

BYU, Ole Miss and LSU fill out the top 10 in Florida's absence. The Rebels were off in Week 5 as well, while BYU beat TCU and LSU beat FCS foe McNeese in a game that Lane Kiffin didn't want to shorten.

Missouri moved up to No. 14 after its big win over the Gators. The Tigers jumped 11 spots from No. 25 and are behind Texas Tech, Utah and Oregon just outside the top 10.

Mississippi State fell only one spot to No. 17 after its loss to Alabama.

Kentucky overcame a 17-0 first-half deficit to beat South Carolina on the road in overtime, but the Wildcats — who were slight underdogs — actually fell out of the top 25 completely. articles.title: Man City 4-2 Arsenal: WSL champions come from behind in thriller to ramp up pressure on Renee Slegers and the Gunners
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as Manchester City continued their perfect start to the season by beating Arsenal 4-2 at the Etihad Stadium; City have won all five games to return to the top of the table, while Arsenal are 10 points further back with one league win all campaign
articles.body:
This was a real advert for the division at the Etihad Stadium - with quality goals, tactical chess-playing from both coaches and controversial moments. But the fall-out will surround how City are still top dogs, and whether Renee Slegers and Arsenal are still in this title fight.

The Gunners were the better team in the first half, with Slegers' side having the better opportunities as Lisa Baum, Emily Fox and Georgia Stanway all went close. It was Baum who gave Arsenal the lead late in the first half as she bundled home from close-range, but replays showed she may have been offside.

Arsenal's lead lasted just three minutes, but City's leveller had a level of controversy to it too. Mariona Caldentey asked to come off and went down injured, but City played on. Thirty-five seconds later, Lauren Hemp forced an own goal off Emily Fox - with Arsenal furious the ball was not put out of play in a sporting gesture.

The second half continued as the first half ended - with drama. After Bunny Shaw - who also saw a first-half opener ruled out for a foul - ran through on goal, she took a heavy touch that allowed Anneke Borde to collect. Forty-five seconds later, Alessia Russo curled Arsenal ahead again after an error while playing out from the back by Ayaka Yamashita.

But the game would turn on its head again - with Arsenal's second-half defending and inability to hold onto a lead letting them down again. First, Kerstin Casparij took 65 seconds - and one touch - to come off the bench to curl a stunner into the far corner.

Then Hemp put City ahead for the first time as the Arsenal defence switched off, allowing her to finish at the far post after a great first touch to trap a ball over the top. Then Shaw got her customary goal late on as Arsenal committed bodies forward.

The pre-match talk surrounded the pressure Slegers and her team were under. Many claimed defeat would put Arsenal out of the Women's Super League title fight after just five games.

One win from the opening five games and 10 points behind the leaders in a 26-game league, they're further into the mire.

And with a long international break ahead, what is next for Slegers?

Watch the goals and read the key moments from Manchester

3: CHANCE! Arsenal get the first chance of the game as Baum's effort from inside the box is tipped behind by Ayaka Yamashita.

11: SAVE! Arsenal continue their promising start as Baum's cross is headed goalwards by Mariona Caldentey, but her effort is sabed again.

25: SAVE! First chance for Shaw to stretch her legs as her solo run sees her enter the box but her drive is straight at goalkeeper Anneke Borbe.

36: GOAL DISALLOWED! Shaw heads in at the back post but the Man City striker is rightly penalised for a foul on Borbe.

37: DOUBLE CHANCE! Fox draws a good save from Yamashita, then Stanway fires into the side netting from the resulting corner.

44: GOAL! Baum gives Arsenal the lead after prodding the ball over the line after Wubben-Moy's header is saved by Yamashita again. However, replays show the goalscorer could have been in an offside position.

45+1: GOAL! With Arsenal furious that City played on with Caldentey down injured, Hemp equalises as her effort goes in off a Fox deflection.

49: WHAT A CHANCE! Shaw breaks through for a one-on-one but takes a heavy touch that allows Borbe to gather at her feet.

50: GOAL! Yamashita's error when playing out the back allows Russo to curl Arsenal in front - 45 seconds after that poor Shaw touch.

62: GOAL! Casparij scores with her first touch - 65 seconds after coming on the pitch as a substitute - with a brilliant curler from distance.

67: BIG CHANCE! Shaw is inches away from tapping Mary Fowler's cross in the box but can't make contact.

72: GOAL! Hemp brilliantly controls a ball over the top and puts City ahead by poking the ball through Borde's legs.

78: CHANCE! Arsenal substitute Olivia Smith cuts inside in the area but can only fire straight at Yamashita.

84: GOAL! With Arsenal throwing bodies forward, City hit them on the break, allowing Shaw to roll the ball into the bottom corner.

Slegers: Arsenal not in title conversation

Arsenal boss Renee Slegers to Sky Sports:

"At the moment, we're not in the title race conversation, no.

"It's been a lot of games where we feel like we have it and then we don't. That's really pressing, demanding mentally. It's good the players go away, go to their national teams, get some new energy, change of environment and they'll come back and then we have the next game to prep for.

"There's a lot to review. How we've been doing things, from all aspects. Training programme, bigger things in the background. We're going to do everything we can to see where we can be better."

'Slegers should stay as Arsenal boss - but she needs to be brave'

Sky Sports' Izzy Christiansen at the Etihad Stadium: "I don't think Renee Slegers' situation should change.

"She's the head coach of Arsenal and she's an outstanding coach and manager. I don't think her position should be under any threat at all. It's clear the cohesion between her and the players.

"That midfield for Arsenal still doesn't quite look right. For me, Kyra Cooney-Cross has to be the one that's ever-present in there. Georgia Stanway has yet to find her feet but you can see the quality we all know she possesses. Kim Little keeps ticking but Renee Slegers is going to have to be brave with her selections going forward.

"It's looking like a two-horse race between Chelsea and Man City. Chelsea have had a superb start to the season as well, playing some superb football. I'm sure London City Lionesses will have something to say about that. They're going from strength to strength."

Rachel Corsie on Sky Sports: "The pressure is not just on Slegers, it's on the whole group.

"When you look at performances, I would say [against City] and against Chelsea they played with enough intensity, enough purpose.

"You can see from the players they are so disappointed with the outcome of today. They are under pressure because they are 10th in the table and that isn't good enough for this team, this squad, the expectations they put on themselves because of the club they are.

"Palace and United, the two draws there have been the beginning of what has now mounted as huge pressure. I think they've still got enough. It's not finished. They're not out of it. But it's an uphill battle from here."

Jeglertz: Arsenal will be there in the spring

"It's not about Arsenal. They are a great football team. They had a struggle in the beginning but it's still a good football team. There are a lot of good players.

"So I'm pretty sure when we end up in the spring that they will definitely be up there and fighting about the title. Nothing changes for them.

"We have had many games when we were down and turned it around, that says something about the group. Both the quality of the group, but also the mentality. Today was another example of that.

"We conceded two easy goals. But at the same time, every time when we attacked, we were coming to their penalty box and creating things. Our attacking play is still very fluent, we score in different ways.

"But we played against a good team today. Arsenal are good team on the ball, we kept them away from our goal. There is momentum in games where Arsenal are better than us. It's about how you deal with that. We dealt with that very well.

"There was a part in the second half where they owned the ball but we didn't let them into our penalty box. It's about dealing with the momentum."

articles.body:
Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith "is the biggest cheat code in the sport" in the view of The Athletic's Dane Brugler .

Brugler offered the remark within the context of the 2027 NFL draft assessment for Buckeyes quarterback Julian Sayin. Evaluating Sayin is a little trickier because having a target as dynamic as Smith can make him look like a better passer than he is.

Nick Baumgardner of The Athletic went on to say "it's fair to put Smith on the Calvin Johnson/Julio Jones dance floor among the best college receiver prospects we've seen this century."

Colorado State DC gets fired mid-game during blowout loss

Smith is leading the FBS in the three major receiving categories. He has 44 receptions for 823 yards and nine touchdowns.

The junior is also Ohio State's all-time leader in all three stats, putting him above the likes of Michael Jenkins, David Boston, Emeka Egbuka, Chris Olave and Marvin Harrison Jr.

At the current pace, the question isn't if Smith is the best player in the 2027 class but rather whether the team with the No. 1 pick values the quarterback position enough to bypass him.

Smith is the top-ranked star on the Bleacher Report big board with a 9.8 overall grade, and he went first to the Miami Dolphins in the B/R mock .

Harrison's struggles in the pros could give some talent evaluators pause on Smith. He was seemingly another can't-miss prospect who had the added benefit of having a Hall of Fame receiver for a dad.

But Smith is surpassing Harrison's collegiate achievements, and the highlights speak for themselves. Barring an unforeseen setback, he'll anchor an NFL passing game for a long time to come.

In time, Smith might be talked about in the same way fans reminisce about Johnson or Randy Moss' college days.

articles.title: El Barcelona destroza al Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: Las azulgrana, con una Pina estelar, firma la victoria más abultada en la historia de los Clásicos
articles.summary: Las azulgrana, con una Pina estelar, firma la victoria más abultada en la historia de los Clásicos
articles.body: Nueva temporada, misma dinámica de siempre. El Barcelona se impuso (7-0) al Real Madrid en el Camp Nou en un duelo donde Claudia Pina, con cuatro goles, fue la gran protagonista de la tarde/noche en la Ciudad Condal. Tres puntos más y pleno de victorias para un conjunto azulgrana que estira su renta en el campeonato doméstico a cinco puntos y el balance de Clásicos a 25-1. El Barcelona encerró al Real Madrid en su propio campo desde el pitido inicial. Con una presión alta y gustándose en un ejercicio perfecto de toque y distribución, dibujó el partido perfecto con un tempranero gol ejecutado por Pina, que anotó a los 227 segundos en una jugada en la que cogió el balón en la medialuna, se internó en el área aprovechando la pasividad defensiva blanca y ejecutó a Frohms con la pierna izquierda. Las azulgrana pidieron penalti por lo que pareció un claro agarrón de Caruso a Schertenleib dentro del área, pero María Planes, tras consulta con el FVS, declinó atender la petición de pena máxima. Poco después fue Cristóbal, de nuevo reconvertida a lateral zurdo -aunque omnipresente en el campo- la que salvó un disparo a bocajarro de Guijarro que ya se cantaba como gol en las gradas. El intento de reacción del Real Madrid se quedó en intento. Sus puntales ofensivos, véase Schröder o Caicedo, pasaron totalmente inadvertidas y el Barcelona fue dominador tanto en posesión como en la contra. En una de ellas nació el segundo tanto del partido. Pina aprovechó el rechace a un primer intento de Pajor para meter el balón en la jaula y aumentar la renta culé. Y como no hay dos sin tres, Claudia firmó su hat trick particular después al hacer una pared con Guijarro y batir con un derechazo a Frohms. El Barcelona echó sal en la herida blanca. Graham hizo el cuarto apenas un minuto después tras una pared con Pajor, regate sobre Lakrar y definición con clase. El primer acto se cerró con el cuarto gol de Pina -y el quinto del Barça-, que repitió pared con Pajor, se deshizo de las centrales blancas con un toque sutil y anotó con otra definición de crack. La segunda parte arrancó como acabó la primera. Un desplazamiento en largo de Guijarro dejó sola ante el peligro a Graham, que templó gaitas para regalar el tanto a Pajor, que hizo el sexto de la tarde. Quesada intentó reanimar a un inoperante centro del campo blanco, del que sacó una a una a todas sus componentes. Acudieron al rescate Irune y Angeldahl primero; Däbritz y Beerensteyn; y finalmente Méndez. Ninguna de ellas pudo más que cambiar la cara al partido. Romeu metiendo en el verde de manera escalonada a Aitana, Kerolin, Martina, Julià y Rosalía. El Barcelona siguió llamando a la puerta del gol. Guijarro, de cabeza; Kerolin, en un mano a mano y otro potente disparo desde la frontal; Rosalía, a bocajarro... hasta que apareció Schertenleib y su latigazo con la pierna derecha para, desde la frontal, sorprender y batir a Frohms para echar el broche a todo un recital.

articles.title: ¿Algún día va a volver a ganar el Real Madrid un clásico al Barcelona?
articles.standfirst: La historia interminable tiene un nuevo capítulo con el mismo final de casi siempre
articles.summary: La historia interminable tiene un nuevo capítulo con el mismo final de casi siempre
articles.body: El FC Barcelona consiguió una nueva victoria ante el Real Madrid. En realidad esta frase la podríamos repetir casi de manera sempiterna. El partido entre las culés y las blancas vuelve a quedar claro que solo tiene un color. Es incomprensible que en un partido ante el Barcelona salgas con la tensión competitiva propia de quién está disputando un partido de pretemporada. Es inexplicable que te hagan un gol en los primeros compases del partido y que, además, sea propiciado por un error tuyo. Pues todo esto lo rompió el Real Madrid. En un día en el que Alexia Putellas solía brillar, Claudia Pina tomó su testigo. Cuatro goles en cuarenta para encarrilar el clásico ante su rival preferido. El traspaso de la corona parece que ya se ha producido y que Pina tiene claro que este es su año. Media hora sensacional de una de las futbolistas más en forma del planeta. Si no gana el Balón de Oro a mejor entrenador de fútbol femenino, sería incomprensible. Es capaz de sacar el máximo rendimiento a sus futbolistas sin que se note la pérdida de piezas que en el pasado eran imprescindibles. Leyó como nadie, dejó que el Real Madrid pisara campo rival, pero le rajó cuando quiso y manejó los tiempos del partido. Si un equipo en el mundo tuviera a una jugadora que ha ganado tres balones de oro en el banquillo, lo echaría de menos. En el Barcelona, siendo Aitana absolutamente diferencial, Pere Romeu puede permitirse el lujo de una integración progresiva sin necesidad de precipitación. Qué equipo. El Real Madrid necesita muchas cosas. Entre ellas creer ferozmente en que la sección de fútbol femenino puede ganar títulos, pero la distancia no puede ser tan grande como para ir perdiendo 5-0 en la primera mitad. No sé si es algo mental, no sé si es extramotivación de las blaugranas, pero es increíble la suficiencia con la que las culés se deshacen de las blancas. Y no es cuestión de un día, ni de un partido, ni de una tendencia. El Real Madrid no puede sostenerse por historia y por escudo en una racha tan negativa contra su máximo rival. Son demasiadas veces las que el conjunto culé ha pasado por encima del equipo blanco. No se puede sostener. Más allá del fútbol, hay algo más. ¿Cuál es la exigencia del Real Madrid Femenino? El año pasado de los tres primeros equipos del cuadro blanco ninguno títulos. El que más lejos estuvo fue el masculino de fútbol, que tuvo dos entrenadores y el banquillo fue cambiado. El de Baloncesto, que jugó la final de la Euroliga, también tuvo relevo. El del femenino que solo aspiró a la Copa de la Reina, se mantuvo. La exigencia es diferente y no sé si puede ser algo que repercutas. No por costumbre tenemos que dejar de elogiar el tratamiento del Barcelona al fútbol femenino. Un Camp Nou con una buena entrada para un partido más en el feudo de un estadio que demuestra tener espacio para las suyas. Una victoria más contra el Real Madrid que parece que, de momento, está lejos... en todos los sentidos.

articles.title: Las cifras de la dictadura azulgrana en los Clásicos: 25-1 y 99-12
articles.standfirst: El Barcelona domina claramente el histórico ante el Real Madrid y aumenta las distancias entre ambos tras la goleada en el Camp Nou
articles.summary: El Barcelona domina claramente el histórico ante el Real Madrid y aumenta las distancias entre ambos tras la goleada en el Camp Nou
articles.body: El vigesimosexto duelo entre Barcelona y Real Madrid, que acabó con una histórica goleada (7-0) en el Camp Nou, amplió la distancia entre ambos equipos. Las azulgrana ya dominan el carrusel de Clásicos 25-1 con 99 goles azulgrana y 12 blancos. En términos de duelos ligueros, el Barcelona domina el enfrentamiento 12-1 con 41 goles azulgrana y cinco blancos. En el campeonato doméstico se disputó el primer Clásico (victoria azulgrana por 0-4 en el estadio Alfredo Di Stéfano el 4 de octubre de 2020) y la única victoria blanca lograda hasta el momento (1-3 en el estadio Lluís Companys el 23 de marzo de 2025). La victoria en el coliseo azulgrana se convierte, además, en la más abultada hasta la fecha superando el 6-0 que firmó el Barcelona en la vuelta de los cuartos de final de la Champions el pasado 2 de abril.

articles.title: Leila Ouahabi ficha por el Gotham
articles.standfirst: Deja el Chicago Stars tras apenas tres meses y se une al actual líder de la NWSL
articles.summary: Deja el Chicago Stars tras apenas tres meses y se une al actual líder de la NWSL
articles.body: Leila Ouahabi cambia el Chicago Stars por Gotham para seguir en la NWSL. La internacional española, de 33 años, pasa así del colista al líder de la NWSL, siendo una nueva etapa tras las consumidas en Barcelona, Valencia, Manchester City y la mencionada en su estreno en Estados Unidos. La de Mataró, que fue anunciada como nueva jugadora de Chicago el pasado 16 de junio, equipo por el que firmó por tres temporadas, dice adiós al proyecto tras apenas tres meses y 11 partidos disputados con un bagaje de 838 minutos disputados y dos tarjetas amarillas recibidas. "Queremos agradecer a Leila su profesionalismo y sus contribuciones a nuestro club durante su tiempo en Chicago", dijo Vlatko Andonovski, director de fútbol del Chicago Stars. "Tras conversar con Leila, coincidimos en que este era el paso correcto para ambas partes. Le deseamos lo mejor en la siguiente etapa de su carrera", añadió. Leila firma ahora por Gotham, equipo dirigido por el también español Juan Carlos Amorós, que actualmente lidera la fase regular de la NWSL con 54 puntos en 26 partidos. El fichaje responde a una intención de reforzar la defensa y lo hace con una futbolista de largo recorrido -puede jugar tanto de lateral como de extremo- y con amplia experiencia internacional. "Estoy muy emocionada de unirme al Gotham y comenzar esta nueva etapa de mi carrera. Este es un club con grandes ambiciones y mentalidad ganadora, y estoy deseando aportar mi experiencia al grupo y competir por más títulos. Estoy lista para ponerme a trabajar, ayudar al equipo en todo lo que pueda y representar al Gotham y a sus seguidores", aseguró Ouahabi tras anunciarse su fichaje. "Leila es una defensa experimentada que ha competido y ganado al más alto nivel. Aporta calidad, versatilidad y mentalidad ganadora a nuestra defensa, además de una valiosa experiencia tanto en Europa como en la NWSL. Estamos encantados de darle la bienvenida a Leila al Gotham FC y esperamos con ilusión lo que aportará a nuestro equipo", añadió Yael Averbuch West, presidenta de operaciones de fútbol del Gotham. En el currículo de Leila se advierten cinco Ligas, seis Copas y dos Supercopa de España; una Liga y otra Copa inglesa; y una Champions League. Además, ha sido internacional con España en 66 ocasiones, siendo su última participación en la final de la Eurocopa de 2025 en la que la selección cayó ante Inglaterra.

articles.title: Oficial: el Albacete elige a Joseba Etxeberria para intentar salir del pozo
articles.standfirst: El de Elgoibar sustituye a Alberto González, destituido tras el desastroso inicio de Liga del equipo manchego
articles.summary: El de Elgoibar sustituye a un Alberto González, destituido tras el desastroso inicio de Liga del equipo manchego
articles.body: A rey muerto, rey puesto. Joseba Etxeberria ya es el nuevo entrenador del Albacete Balompié, apenas 24 horas después de la destitución de Alberto González tras la derrota ante el Eibar (1-3) que deja al equipo colista con 1 punto de 24 posibles. El técnico vasco, nacido en Elgoibar hace 49 años, llega a la capital manchega acompañado de su cuerpo técnico de confianza (su segundo José Antonio Valle y Javi González como preparador físico) y firma hasta final de temporada. Mañana lunes, a las 11, dirigirá su primer entrenamiento en la Ciudad Deportiva Andrés Iniesta y después será presentado. El martes debutará en el banquillo en la final del Trofeo JCCM, que enfrentará al Alba con el Talavera en La Fuensanta de Cuenca. Etxeberria aterriza en Albacete con una misión urgente: enderezar una situación límite. El conjunto blanco no conoce la victoria en las ocho primeras jornadas. El nuevo entrenador conoce bien la Segunda división, con más de 150 partidos en la categoría. Ha dirigido al Tenerife, al Mirandés y al Eibar, con el que peleó por el ascenso en la campaña 2023-2024. Su última experiencia fue en el Real Murcia, en Primera RFEF, al que entrenó al inicio de la pasada temporada. Por su parte, Alberto González se despidió este domingo en una rueda de prensa cargada de emoción. El malagueño se mostró agradecido por la oportunidad de llegar al fútbol profesional y por el trato recibido tanto dentro del club como en una ciudad que, aseguró, "llevará siempre dentro". Tras comparecer ante los medios, el técnico de Tolox se despidió de la plantilla y del cuerpo técnico en un ambiente muy emotivo, cerrando una etapa de dos años y medio al frente del conjunto manchego.

articles.title: As a manager, it’s important to use common sense: Diego Forlan
articles.summary: Kolkata: Diego Forlan won’t have pleasant memories of his last visit to Kolkata.
articles.body: Kolkata: Diego Forlan won’t have pleasant memories of his last visit to Kolkata. It was a decade ago, when as captain and marquee player of Mumbai City FC, the Uruguay star battled for a place in the Indian Super League (ISL) final against Atletico de Kolkata, only to petulantly pick up a red card.Atletico de Kolkata went on to clinch a five-goal thriller, and Forlan’s second-half sending off killed Mumbai’s chances.“I was disappointed because I think if I weren’t sent off in that game, we should have won,” Forlan tells TOI, slightly sheepish. “We played them a couple of times and won quite well. We were the best team (at the end of the league stage).”Forlan returns to Kolkata on Tuesday for a friendly against India. This time he’s the Uruguay coach, tasked with improving the nation’s fortunes after a disastrous World Cup, where they were knocked out in the group stage after picking up two points from three games.“It’s a privilege to coach Uruguay, regardless of the circumstances. I don’t know if it’s the right time. I had the opportunity and I took it up. Uruguay is a great national team, with great players, and till I am the coach, I will try to enjoy every game.”Forlan has taken over the team’s charge from Marcelo Bielsa, possibly football’s most philosophical coach. Bielsa’s stint started with plenty of promise as Uruguay defeated Argentina and Brazil in away games. But the team later disintegrated, eventually ending in a “very painful” exit.By Bielsa’s own admission, nobody seemed interested in what he said.Forlan is unlikely to face such a mutiny. After all, he’s a Golden Ball winner at the FIFA World Cup 2010 and the country’s most decorated footballer.“Just because I won the Golden Ball, it does not mean that everything I say or do will be correct,” says Forlan. “I’m human and I know things are right and wrong. I try to use common sense (while coaching). I work with the players, try to have a good group, enjoy what they are doing.“Of course, as manager, I will have a way of playing, a way of trying to do things. As (a former) player, the advantage is of experience. You know how to use your experience because you understand the players better. You know everything. It’s important to use common sense.”Uruguay has a rich footballing history, deeply embedded in the national culture. A country of just three million people, there is a remarkable sense of close-knit community and underdog spirit that bonds its national team. Uruguay rarely gives an inch on the field, and, in the eyes of some, carries a ‘dirty’ image.Forlan sees it differently.“People talk about the way we play but I think sometimes it’s a little bit mistaken. It’s not that we are rough; it’s the way we play till the end of the game, doesn’t matter who we are up against. We know every game will be very difficult, but we will make it even more difficult for our opponents. That’s how we play. That’s the spirit we carry on the field.”Forlan’s appointment as interim coach ends next March. He does not have the luxury of counting upon the expertise of Uruguay’s most famous striking duo of Luis Suarez and Edinson Cavani, who between them have 280 international appearances. Playing alongside both, the coach has fond memories, but feels it’s time to move ahead“I enjoyed playing with them and as a Uruguayan fan, I enjoyed watching them with the national team, scoring many goals in different World Cups,” says Forlan. “Now, we don’t have to think how we can fill the gap (after their retirement). articles.title: Montella: ‘Don’t want to think negatively, will not accept illogical criticism’
articles.summary: Vincenzo Montella does ‘not want to think negatively’ ahead of Turkiye’s Nations League match against Italy, despite reports he could soon be fired. ‘I canno...
articles.body:
Vincenzo Montella does 'not want to think negatively' ahead of Turkiye's Nations League match against Italy, despite reports he could soon be fired. 'I cannot accept illogical criticism.'

It kicks off at the Stadio Dall'Ara in Bologna on Monday at 19.45 UK time (20.45 CEST).

The pressure is mounting on the Italian tactician, who was already under attack after a disappointing performance at the 2026 World Cup this summer.

He has started the Nations League campaign with three defeats, 1-0 to France, 4-1 with Italy , and then 3-0 away to Belgium, prompting calls for his dismissal.

INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA – JUNE 25: Vincenzo Montella, Head Coach of Turkiye, looks on during the FIFA World Cup 2026 Group D match between Türkiye and USA at Los Angeles Stadium on June 25, 2026 in Inglewood, California. (Photo by Alex Grimm/Getty Images)

"We want to win, compete and challenge ourselves at this level," said Montella in his press conference.

"For most of the three games, we had our say and the result was in the balance for long periods, except for the match with Italy. We are motivated, curious to see what happens and eager to get a result, because just playing on level terms is not sufficient."

This is nowhere near the strongest Turkiye side that Montella could draw upon, because Juventus forward Kenan Yildiz and Inter midfielder Hakan Calhanoglu are injured.

DORTMUND, GERMANY – JUNE 18: Vincenzo Montella, Head Coach of Turkiye, gestures during the UEFA EURO 2024 group stage match between Turkiye and Georgia at Football Stadium Dortmund on June 18, 2024 in Dortmund, Germany. (Photo by Dean Mouhtaropoulos/Getty Images)

Real Madrid talent Arda Guler was sent off against Belgium and is also therefore suspended, further weakening the squad.

"These are all important players for us, just as they are for their respective clubs. Nonetheless, this is a good opportunity to see new players in action and get to evaluate them.

"I am confident we'll be competitive despite the absences, and try to bring home a victory."

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Vincenzo Montella, Head Coach of Turkiye, gestures during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)

His record for Turkiye since taking the job in October 2023 is of 21 victories, five draws and 13 defeats, during which he earned promotion to Nations League A and qualification for their first World Cup in 24 years.

"I am accustomed to the dynamics of football, I know and accept them," added the coach.

"What I cannot accept is illogical criticism. What I consider to be constructive criticism, I can appreciate. It is the first time in Turkiye's history that we are in the Nations League A, and I am the only coach to have taken us to that level.

"We'd love to play more competitive matches like the one against France, or the second half with Italy, but we are struggling to score goals. With Belgium, we were in the penalty area on 42 occasions and I asked what more I could do.

INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA – JUNE 24: Head coach Vincenzo Montella of Türkiye talks to the media during a press conference one day ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026 Group D match between Türkiye and USA at Los Angeles Stadium on June 24, 2026 in Inglewood, California. (Photo by Jamie Squire/Getty Images)

"A few days ago, I was asked if I knew a striker who scored almost 100 goals in the Turkish third division, then I found out he was 32 years old. If it had been someone we could develop for the future, I would've taken him into consideration, but this kind of illogical criticism hurts me.

"I understand people might be upset after the early World Cup exit, but we went into the tournament with our top players not in great shape.

"This can be one way of reading it, but in football there are always new objectives and opportunities, so we must learn from that elimination and develop."

It is special for Montella to be back on Italian soil, and up against his former Sampdoria teammate Roberto Mancini on the touchline, but he was asked if he knew this might be his last game as Turkiye coach.

"I am determined, motivated and a professional who always gives his all with passion and a pure heart. This is my state of mind, even though I know the dynamics of football all too well. I don't want to think negatively."
